text:
**FIX.** I couldn't read rules 1–31 or the owner's words in this budget. The checks below come from the image and the plan box, so they may miss a rule.

1. **Leftover debug block (col 1, "Swap menu check").** It still says "Do you see folders… Reply yes or no in chat." That is a test prompt on a finished page. Delete it.
2. **Stray dot in ".500 Preview" (col 1).** The label starts with a dot. Rename it "500 · Preview".
3. **Rule 12, big voids.** Col 1 is empty below the preview (y 690–820). Col 2 is empty below Wrappers (610–820). Col 4 is empty below Profile (470–820). The columns are very uneven: Content is full while App is about 40% filled. Rebalance the groups across columns, or shrink the page height.
4. **Wrong number (col 2, "Wrappers/400 · Stack").** It holds three "500 · Default" instances, though it is a 400 wrapper. Use 400 Defaults, or rename the wrapper.
5. **Squeezed items (col 2, "Wrappers/500 · 2 · Equal").** Two 360 Defaults sit in a 500 stage, so each is squeezed to about 250 wide. Use 250-wide Defaults, or put a 500 Default in each column.
6. **Near-duplicates (col 3, Content).** The "for a 400" and "for a 500" sets repeat the same Content, Text, Text+Media and Stat trio. They also show the same seagull photo twice, and the plan allows at most one photo. Keep one set, or give the second set different content.
7. **Near-duplicates (col 2, Defaults).** The /360, /400 and /500 Defaults look the same and differ only in width. Keep this only if each is a distinct master. "Content/500 · 2 · Equal" also repeats the preview's Left/Right column.
8. **Ugly wraps.** "400 · Default" breaks onto two lines in col 2 and "360 · Default" in col 1. Reduce the big label font or let the stage hug the text.
9. **Plan mismatch.** The plan box says the first page is "600 SM" (360, 400 and 600 merged), but this page is "500 SM". Confirm that is intended.
10. **Rule 18 alignment (col 3).** The Content/400 trio's purple outlines have different heights and tops, so they read as floating, and the Stat sits alone on its own row. Top-align the row, or group the three so the last one fills the row.
The task stays open on purpose. The brief says more pages will be sent later in this same session, so I'm waiting for the next one and will complete the task after the last review.
Those inbox lines are my own two messages echoed back, so there is nothing new to act on. I'm still waiting for the next page to review.

**500 SM: FIX (minor)**
1. **Voids (cols 1–2).** Col 1 is empty below the preview (y 690–880), and col 2 is empty below Wrappers (550–880). Col 3 is now the tallest, so the page height is set by Content. Move the Wrappers or the preview into the shorter columns, or move the App group out of col 4 so the columns even out.
2. **Misalignment (col 3, 400 set).** The 400 Content row is not top-aligned: the Text stage (y 175–230) is far shorter than the placeholder (175–270) and the photo (185–328). Only the tops line up, and the labels above them sit at different heights because the Text + Media label wraps to two lines. Shorten that name or align the stage tops.
3. **Floating Stat (col 3).** The 400 Stat sits alone on its own row with a large void to its right (y 365–460). The 500 set has the same shape. Put the Stat beside the Text stage, or pair the two Stats in one row.
4. **Photo cropped to a strip (col 3, 500 Text + Media).** The 436 Content photo is larger than the 400 one, so the same seagull appears at two sizes. The masters are intended, so this is fine, but make sure both crops are not the same strip.

**1000 Default: FIX**
1. **Sidebar not "Fill" height, and not 250:750 (col 2, Wrappers/1000 · 2 · Sidebar).** The sidebar looks about 90 wide against about 270 for the main area, which is roughly 1:3 and not 250:750. The sidebar surface is shorter than the main-area card, with a gap under it. Make the sidebar fill the full height, and check the fixed 250 width.
2. **Preview (col 1) is far from your ask.** It has no flush section with radius 0 and no shadow: the dark band is full width with square corners, but the "flush" demo is not labelled as one. It also stacks seven near-similar white cards. The two 500s, the columns and the sidebar are all small variants of the same white card. Label each block, and cut the Left/Right column card, because the "Content in columns" column already shows it.
3. **Near-duplicates (cols 3–4).** "Content/1000 · Content · Hero" repeats the preview's Hero and "Text + Button" is almost the same as it. In col 4, "2 · Equal", "1/3 + 2/3", "2/3 + 1/3" and "3 · Equal" are four very similar one-line cards. Keep Equal, 1/3 + 2/3 and 3 · Equal, and drop the mirror 2/3 + 1/3.
3b. **Photo (col 4, Text + Media).** The photo overflows its card: the card runs to y 310 but the text has a big void beneath it. Make the stage hug the content, or top-align the text beside the photo.
4. **Voids (cols 2 and 4).** Col 2 is empty below y 735 and col 4 below y 970, while col 3 runs to y 1020. Balance the columns, or move the Wrappers group under Content.
5. **Wrong or odd numbers.** "Content/1000 · Content" is labelled 904 wide, which matches the stage. The Defaults/1000 stage is 1000 wide and is shown the same size as the 904 Content stages in col 3, so the widths look the same on the page even though the labels differ. Scale-consistent stage widths would help.
I'm idle. I've sent the review of the updated 500 SM page and the new 1000 Default page, and I'm waiting for the next page. The task stays open until the last review.

The 1920 Desktop and Index reviews are above (FIX on both), and my task is now complete.

- **1920 Desktop:** the Defaults note says "radius 0, no shadow" but the stage is a shadowed card, and the Sidebar wrapper's label doesn't match what it holds.
- **Index:** the dashboard tile repeats in the 1000 and 1920 groups, and the 1000 and 1920 columns end well short of the 500 column.

I had only the images and the plan box to judge from. I didn't read Figma rules 1–31 or the owner's words in full, so a rule-based problem could have slipped past, and the completion line records medium confidence.
